command: for c in sandbox-exec bwrap bubblewrap unshare nsenter setpriv firejail podman docker; do printf '%s: ' "$c"; command -v $c || echo MISSING; done; echo 'ns: '$(ls /proc/self/ns 2>/dev/null || echo '<no /proc/self/ns>'); echo 'lsm: '$(cat /sys/kernel/security/lsm 2>/dev/null || echo '<unreadable>')
stdout_excerpt:
sandbox-exec: /usr/bin/sandbox-exec
bwrap: MISSING
bubblewrap: MISSING
unshare: MISSING
nsenter: MISSING
setpriv: MISSING
firejail: MISSING
podman: MISSING
docker: /usr/local/bin/docker
ns: <no /proc/self/ns>
lsm: <unreadable>
